comments.content: [medium] Possible API contract mismatch: `GooglePayPredecrypt.token` is typed as `cards::CardNumber`, but the assigned value comes from `application_primary_account_number.clone()`. If that field is a plain `String`/`Secret<String>` (typical for decrypted PANs), this will either fail to compile or serialize in an unexpected format. Safer to convert/validate explicitly (e.g., `cards::CardNumber::from_str` / `CardNumber::try_from`) and map errors to `InvalidDataFormat` so failures are actionable.
[low] Add a test that exercises `expiry_month` with an unexpected-but-well-formed value.
[low] Consider avoiding an implicit assumption about `GooglePayPredecrypt.token` by validating it at entry.
